gates.description: No live Hara compiler/runtime namespace begins with tahto.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara#371 hard-cut live compiler/runtime namespaces to lang.* without forwarding namespaces; the pinned Hara revision retains that boundary.

gates.description: New Hara compiler records write :lang/* rather than :tahto/*.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara#372 moved serialized Hara metadata to :lang.../* and #373 stabilized the post-migration paths; the pinned Hara revision includes those changes and the later Workspace/runtime repairs.

gates.description: The Greenways OS over Tahto architecture ADR is merged.
greenways-ai/tahto exists with reviewable repository history.
gates.evidence: Tahto is pinned at 85eff7d5f69d6b80099a159a9f5a68086c7efe2a, containing object custody, immutable history, backup/restore plans, device identity, replay protection, incremental sync planning, inert service registrations, durable jobs and the TAHTO-7 atomic metadata transaction plan.

gates.description: Two devices exchange only missing objects, preserve signed divergent heads, create and restore a complete backup, and reject tampering, stale sequences and replayed nonces.
gates.evidence: The pinned Hoplite revision includes bounded request ABI V3, ordinary-source Nginx request-body binding and corrected native response ownership through request cleanup. The pinned Tahto revision includes the TAHTO-3 through TAHTO-7 Hara state-kernel line and 97 passing conformance tests, including deterministic atomic composition of nonce, idempotency, domain mutation, result identity and metadata revision. A concrete compare-and-swap metadata provider, installed signature/freshness/result-verification providers, provider-backed replay retention, native object transfer and response-source streaming, OS pairing/revocation UX and the complete two-device fixture remain outstanding.
